description:
# 1.2.0

Bug fix release for YouTube 19.16.39.

Bug Fixes:

- YouTube - Add missing resources: Restore missing Shorts bottom sheet captions/subtitles text in phone/high-DPI layouts without replacing the original menu command.
- YouTube - Add missing resources: Map modern Shorts search, overflow, and back Cairo icon names back to 19.16.39's legacy white Shorts top-bar glyphs.
- YouTube - Add missing resources: Keep the legacy Shorts menu crash guard for unsupported modern menu rows.

Changes:

- YouTube - Spoof app version: Update the preset list to 20.02.34, 20.05.46, 20.14.43, and 20.24.39 with English and Spanish labels.

Credits:

- anddea/revanced-patches
- MorpheApp/morphe-patches and MorpheApp/morphe-manager
- kitadai31/revanced-patches-android6-7
